ITEM 1 | Pale green-yellow lettuce leaves with darker green edges, crisp and wilted in places, a light dressing sheen, spread in a loose mound on the upper left of the plate, roughly 12 x 9 cm footprint, about 3 cm tall | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-white shaved hard cheese shards, flat irregular flakes about 1 to 3 cm, dry-looking with a slight edge curl, scattered on top of the lettuce | 8
ITEM 3 | Thin pale tan noodles tangled with thin orange carrot strips and small flecks of green and yellow strands, glossy with light oil, loosely piled in the lower left, roughly 12 x 8 cm, about 2 cm tall | 85
ITEM 4 | Two wedges of pizza in the upper right with orange-gold crust edge, red tomato sauce, melted pale cheese, and round pepperoni slices with slightly curled, glossy red-brown edges; each wedge about 10 x 5 cm, about 1.5 cm thick | 130
ITEM 5 | Orange carrot slices and batons, some roasted with browned edges, glossy with light oil, lying in a cluster on the right, pieces about 3 to 5 cm long and 1 cm thick | 55
ITEM 6 | Cubes of pale off-white firm tofu with slightly golden browned surfaces, about 2 cm cubes, scattered in the center beside the carrots | 40
ITEM 7 | Browned roasted chunks of mixed vegetable or meat-like pieces with darker caramelized edges and a dull matte surface, about 3 cm pieces, clustered on the lower right | 50
ITEM 8 | Small dark red roasted pepper pieces with charred black spots and a soft, slightly glossy skin, about 3 cm, one near the center | 15
ITEM 9 | Small crumbs and specks of toasted seasoning or nut-like bits, dry and dark brown, scattered sparsely across the plate near the tofu and noodles | 3
